t: This is the Shepherd's Bush Pavilion, now the Dorsett hotel. Only part of the façade is the original, because the rest was demolished in 2012. It was built in 1923 as a cinema, designed by Frank Verity, an architect known for cinemas in the boom after the First World War. A flying bomb badly damaged it in 1944, and it reopened in 1955. It became a bingo hall in 1983 and closed in 2001. The rebuilt hotel opened in 2014, and the building is Grade II listed.
